meta.note: Evidence-Gap Register entries of the FX part; also written as GOVERNANCE/register/EG-FX-nn.md

gaps.title: Wheatfield fire
gaps.description: No documented wheat-field fire; S-033 uses "fire" for gunfire (forum citing Pfanz, low reliability).
gaps.substitute: Not drawn. Trampling is the structures layer's business.

gaps.title: Rogers house, Schmucker Hall, other buildings burned
gaps.description: Only fires documented in the repository are built (Sherfy barn, Bliss house and barn, Rock Creek trestle, rail cars at the station, carcass fires). Rogers, Schmucker and the McPherson barn did not burn (rule RULE-01).

gaps.title: Caledonia Furnace and the Gettysburg covered bridge
gaps.description: Burning documented (T1-005, T1-015, W-BG) but no position for either in the structures data.
gaps.substitute: Not drawn. A position needs a source (HABS, 1850s maps).

gaps.title: Common-shell bursting charge
gaps.description: The repository holds the 1.0 oz spherical-case bursting charge (ORD-PRJ-CASE) but no shell charge.

gaps.title: Canister cone angle and ground-strike pattern
gaps.description: PDF B.6.14.2 gives 27 balls inside 350-400 yd; no spread angle.

gaps.title: Smoke, dust and flame physics of 1863
gaps.description: The PDF supplies no measured smoke yield, extinction, plume rise, flame length or dust yield; T2-122 is itself plausible-procedural ("sector-by-sector smoke accounts were not found").
gaps.substitute: Physically coherent look parameters, every one tier-marked in TIERS.json; the benchmark is the plan's G12 band (flash 80-150 ms, plume 15-25 s, dirt column 10-25 m).

gaps.title: March cadence and dust accounts
gaps.description: drill/*.json has no marching cadence; the PDF says "no direct dust accounts".
gaps.substitute: Gait comes from the animation; 90 steps/min fallback, marked inferred. Dust drawn only when the ground is dry by the wetness model.

gaps.title: Fire timing inside date-only windows, and burn durations
gaps.description: Sherfy barn (Jul 2 evening to Jul 3 afternoon), Bliss (Jul 3 morning), trestle (Jun 26 or 27): the part of the day is not recorded; no burn duration is recorded for any building.
gaps.substitute: Fire drawn at half intensity and marked "time uncertain" inside the window; growth, peak and decline times are plausible-procedural. The owner picks a scenario or a clock (PENDING OWNER).

gaps.title: Wind speed and direction
gaps.description: Speed conflict 2 vs 12 mph (CF-WIND-SPEED, PENDING OWNER); direction not recorded for Jun 26-30 and Jul 4; "no breeze during the Charge" is qualitative.
gaps.substitute: The effects follow the environment layer's chosen scenario; unrecorded days use S-SSW and are flagged; Jul 3 13:00-16:30 wind scaled by params.wind.calm_charge_scale.

gaps.title: Powder charge of small arms other than the .58 rifle-musket; charges of rifled field guns and gap pieces
gaps.description: Only the 60-grain rifled-musket charge and the smoothbore field-gun and howitzer service charges are in printed manuals in the repository.
gaps.substitute: Other arms scaled by bore area from the documented 60 grains (plausible-procedural); rifled guns use the kit table (inferred, weak source).

gaps.title: Muzzle-flash jet length and duration per weapon
gaps.description: Only the project's own estimates exist (audio/contract/FIRE_EVENT.md section 3; render G12): "tens of ms", "several metres", "50-100 ms" and "80-150 ms".
gaps.substitute: Jet length L = k * cbrt(charge) with k fitted to those words; duration carried as the union range.

gaps.title: Fuse trails at night
gaps.description: The plan lists fuse trails as a night light source (T2-203) and marks it plausible-procedural ("no night-light accounts were found").
gaps.substitute: Drawn for timed-fuze projectiles only (shell, spherical case), never for solid shot, canister or percussion rifled shell; marked.

gaps.title: Horse-carcass fires: where and until when
gaps.description: 3,000-5,000 horses burned with kerosene "where possible" from Jul 4 (T3-150); no positions, no end.
gaps.substitute: Host places them; window starts Jul 4 00:00 (date only); marked.

gaps.title: Burning fence rails
gaps.description: Leister rails burned (S-059), Thompson fences burned for firewood (T3-067): cause and extent unrecorded.

gaps.title: Camp-fire positions
gaps.description: Rear camp fires are plausible-procedural in the PDF; no positions recorded.
gaps.substitute: Host-placed; refused within params.fire.campfire.contact_clearance_m of an enemy or a firing line.

gaps.title: Nothing seen
gaps.description: Rule for this round: no browser, no GPU. The shader code (WebGL2 and WebGPU), the look, the performance and the lighting are unverified.
